overview.zh: AI资本与算力扩张加速，同时风险沿能源、市场与安全环节外溢 AI融资：Anthropic获谷歌、亚马逊和博通合计770亿美元融资，其中谷歌200亿美元承诺部分取决于营收目标。 预测市场：NBA指定Kalshi与Polymarket为首选预测市场平台，并保留对可上线NBA相关市场的审批权。 跨资产传导：比特币跌破80,000美元，彭博社将其归因于AI相关市场抛售加深带来的避险压力。
overview.en: AI capital and compute expansion accelerate as risk spills into energy, markets and security AI financing：Anthropic secured $77 billion from Google, Amazon and Broadcom, with Google's $20 billion partly tied to revenue targets. Prediction markets：The NBA named Kalshi and Polymarket preferred platforms while retaining approval rights over which NBA markets they list. Cross-asset spillover：Bitcoin fell below $80,000, which Bloomberg tied to risk-off pressure from a deeper AI-related market selloff.

title.zh: 与学术社区合作，共建科学理解
title.en: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding

summary.zh:
2026年10月26日，OpenAI 宣布其模型给出了三项长期悬而未决结果的自然语言证明：Kakeya 猜想相关的局部光滑（local smoothing）、指数时间假设（ETH）为假，以及量子色动力学与标准模型完备化的存在性。其中 Yang–Mills 存在性证明生成于2026年9月9日，QCD 证明生成于9月18日，发布被推迟至10月16日 Yang–Mills 结果的 Lean 形式化完成后才进行。

OpenAI 将此次发布定位为研究者如何验证并在此基础上继续推进，并称正因工作量庞大且复杂，才等到 Lean 形式化完成后才公布。具备复杂性理论背景的评论者认为，ETH 被推翻是其中影响最大的一项，因为 ETH 是许多困难性与下界结果的基石。

局部光滑方面的主张被认为一并解决了任意维度的 Kakeya 猜想与 Stein 限制性猜想，该问题自1991年起悬而未决。目前尚无对这些证明的独立验证报道；发布当日的报道称相关结果仍未经核实。
summary.en:
OpenAI announced on October 26, 2026 that its models produced natural-language proofs of three long-standing open results: local smoothing for the Kakeya conjecture, the falsity of the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), and the existence of quantum chromodynamics and completions of the Standard Model. The Yang–Mills existence proof was generated on September 9, 2026 and the QCD proof on September 18, 2026, with the release held back until Lean formalization of the Yang–Mills result was completed on October 16, 2026.

OpenAI framed the release around how researchers can verify and build on the results, and said the volume and complexity of the work was why publication waited on Lean formalization. Commenters with complexity-theory background treated an ETH refutation as the most consequential item, since ETH underpins many hardness and lower-bound results.

The local smoothing claim is presented as settling Kakeya and Stein's restriction conjecture in every dimension, a problem open since 1991. No independent verification of the proofs has been reported; coverage at the time of the announcement described the results as still unverified.

title.zh: 谷歌、亚马逊和博通向Anthropic提供770亿美元融资
title.en: Google, Amazon and Broadcom Provide $77 Billion in Financing to Anthropic

summary.zh:
据 BlockBeats 10 月 26 日消息，Anthropic 已从谷歌、亚马逊和博通处获得总计 770 亿美元的额外融资。每项协议均附带各自条件：亚马逊的融资与 Anthropic 达到特定算力里程碑挂钩，谷歌的 200 亿美元承诺则部分取决于 Anthropic 能否实现特定营收目标。

这些承诺将 Anthropic 的资金与算力建设和营收表现直接绑定，使资本投放与可衡量的运营里程碑挂钩，而非一次性投入。谷歌和亚马逊累计向 Anthropic 投资数百亿美元，已成为其最大股东。

在总额中，谷歌的部分为 200 亿美元承诺，部分取决于营收目标；亚马逊的协议则围绕算力容量里程碑设定。报道称，谷歌和亚马逊既是 Anthropic 的投资方，同时也是其竞争对手。
summary.en:
Anthropic has secured a total of $77 billion in additional financing from Google, Amazon and Broadcom, according to a BlockBeats report dated October 26. Each agreement carries its own conditions: Amazon's tranche is tied to Anthropic reaching specific compute-capacity milestones, while Google's $20 billion commitment is partly contingent on Anthropic meeting certain revenue targets.

The commitments tie Anthropic's funding directly to compute buildout and revenue performance, linking capital to measurable operational milestones rather than a single lump-sum investment. Google and Amazon have now collectively invested tens of billions of dollars in Anthropic and are its largest shareholders.

Of the total, Google's portion is a $20 billion commitment that is partly conditional on revenue targets; Amazon's agreement is structured around compute-capacity milestones. The report characterizes Google and Amazon as simultaneously investors in and competitors of Anthropic.

title.zh: 【NBA 与 Kalshi、Polymarket 达成预测市场合作协议】
title.en: NBA reaches prediction market partnership agreements with Kalshi and Polymarket

summary.zh:
NBA 周一宣布，Kalshi 与 Polymarket 将成为其首选预测市场平台，可使用由 Sportradar 提供的联盟官方数据结算 NBA 相关市场、使用 NBA 及球队标识，并在比赛转播中投放广告；同时 NBA 保留对两家平台可上线的 NBA 相关市场的审批权。联盟还表示已与美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）签署谅解备忘录，并将其与 DraftKings 的现有合作扩大至预测市场，预计未来数周与 FanDuel、Fanatics 达成类似安排。

这些协议让两家平台在 NBA 相关市场上获得官方数据、联盟品牌授权与转播曝光，这是北美主要职业体育联盟此前未给予预测市场交易所的背书程度。随附的 CFTC 信息共享协议，则在行业围绕联邦与州监管权限的诉讼持续之际，为预测市场增添了一条监管合法性渠道。

在诚信条款下，NBA 球员、球队及联盟工作人员不得交易 NBA 事件合约，Kalshi 与 Polymarket 须协助联盟识别可疑交易、防范内幕交易，并在调查中共享数据。CFTC 主席 Michael S. Selig 表示，与 NBA 的协议将加强针对内幕交易和欺诈的信息共享；NBA 由此加入美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）和北美职业冰球联盟（NHL）的行列，与该监管机构建立类似安排。
summary.en:
The NBA announced Monday that Kalshi and Polymarket will become its preferred prediction-market platforms, able to settle NBA-related markets using official league data supplied by Sportradar, use NBA and team marks, and advertise during game broadcasts, while the league retains approval rights over which NBA markets they may list. The league also said it signed a memorandum of understanding with the CFTC, expanded its existing DraftKings deal to cover prediction markets, and expects similar arrangements with FanDuel and Fanatics in the coming weeks.

The deals give the two platforms official data, league branding and broadcast exposure tied to NBA markets, a level of endorsement a major North American league had not previously extended to prediction-market exchanges. The accompanying CFTC information-sharing agreement adds a regulatory-legitimacy channel alongside the industry's ongoing court fight over federal versus state oversight.

Under the integrity provisions, NBA players, team and league personnel are barred from trading NBA event contracts, and Kalshi and Polymarket must help the league identify suspicious trading, prevent insider trading and share data in investigations. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said the NBA agreement would strengthen information sharing on insider trading and fraud; the NBA joins Major League Baseball and the National Hockey League in establishing such arrangements with the regulator.

title.zh: Keystone 数据泄露事件曝光 25,964 条购买记录，设备验证密钥遭窃
title.en: Keystone Breach Exposed 25,964 Purchase Records and Compromised Device Verificat

summary.zh:
Keystone 表示，调查发现入侵其网站的攻击者获取了用于验证硬件钱包真伪的 WebAuth 设备认证密钥，这可能让仿冒设备通过官方真伪校验。公司将销毁 18,835 台使用旧密钥的未售出设备，暂停未发货订单，并将新生产切换至替换密钥；此次事件涉及 25,964 条购买记录和 12,873 条未完成的结账记录。

密钥泄露削弱了用户用来确认真伪的设备校验环节，尽管 Keystone 表示助记词、私钥和交易签名均未受影响。泄露的购买数据（姓名、联系方式、收货地址和订单详情）带来钓鱼风险，已有用户报告有人利用 Keystone 订单信息实施社会工程学电话诈骗。

Keystone 表示，受影响记录仅限于通过其官网 Shopify 完成的购买，并承认其自动数据删除工具“运行不可靠”，导致部分个人信息在承诺期限之后仍被保留；公司还称另有约 25,000 条记录已按保留政策被永久删除。
summary.en:
Keystone said its investigation found that attackers who breached its website obtained the WebAuth device-authentication key used to verify that a hardware wallet is genuine, potentially allowing counterfeit devices to pass official authenticity checks. The company will destroy 18,835 unsold devices built with the old key, pause unshipped orders and move new production to a replacement key, while the incident affected 25,964 purchase records and 12,873 incomplete checkout records.

The compromised key undermines the authenticity check customers rely on to confirm a device is genuine, even though Keystone said seed phrases, private keys and transaction signing were not compromised. The exposed purchase data — names, contact details, shipping addresses and order details — creates phishing risk, and one customer had already reported a social-engineering call that used Keystone order information.

Keystone said the affected records were limited to purchases made through Shopify on its official site, and that its automated data-deletion tool "did not operate reliably," so some personal information was retained beyond the promised period; it also said another roughly 25,000 records had already been permanently erased under its retention policy.

title.zh: Anthropic 靠烧天然气支撑 AI 热潮
title.en: Anthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boom

summary.zh:
Anthropic 周一向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交的公开 S-1 文件披露，其数据中心建设正日益依赖天然气，并写明“获取电力供应和电力充足的数据中心选址的竞争非常激烈”。该文件同时披露了在纳斯达克上市、股票代码为 ANT 的计划。

这份文件使 AI 的能源供应与气候暴露在头部实验室上市前成为公开市场投资者面前一项明确的风险因素，而不再是外部批评者提出的背景性议题。

被引述的表述属于风险披露，而非已确定的采购计划。对同一份文件的报道还指出，Anthropic 约五分之一的收入来自两家客户。
summary.en:
Anthropic's public S-1 filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday discloses that its data center buildout is increasingly reliant on natural gas, and states that "competition for access to electrical supply and data center locations with adequate power availability is intense." The filing also sets out plans to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.

The filing makes AI's energy supply and climate exposure an explicit risk factor for public-market investors ahead of a frontier lab's listing, rather than a background concern raised by outside critics.

The quoted language appears as a risk disclosure rather than a committed procurement plan. Coverage of the same filing noted that roughly one-fifth of Anthropic's revenue came from two customers.

title.zh: 卢拉意外获胜后巴西股市暴跌
title.en: Brazil’s Stock Market Crashes After Lula’s Upset Victory

summary.zh:
周日决选投票中，总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦以51.79%对48.21%击败参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，周一开盘巴西股市市值蒸发逾2000亿美元。iShares MSCI Brazil ETF（EWZ）从周五约42.60美元的收盘价最低跌至31.40美元，跌幅达26%；美元兑雷亚尔一度上涨12%；圣保罗交易所B3触发30分钟熔断，为新冠疫情以来首次。

这一结果与预测市场Polymarket和Kalshi的定价相悖——投票前一天两家平台给博索纳罗开出的胜率接近80%。博索纳罗周日晚表示不承认选举结果，将请求法院宣布选举无效，使政治不确定性在市场开盘之外继续延烧。

Ibovespa指数最低下跌17%至约170000点，跌幅触及10%后触发暂停交易，30分钟熔断结束后继续走低；对以美元计价的投资者而言，汇率与指数跌幅叠加，最差时合计损失约26%。据巴西最高选举法院，卢拉领先约440万票；而Datafolha最新民调显示，有效票中双方各为50%。
summary.en:
Brazil’s equity market lost more than $200 billion in value at Monday’s open after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in Sunday’s runoff, 51.79% to 48.21%. The iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ) fell as much as 26% from Friday’s close of about $42.60 to $31.40, the dollar rose as much as 12% against the real, and São Paulo exchange B3 halted trading for 30 minutes — its first circuit breaker since the COVID-19 pandemic.

The result contradicted prediction markets Polymarket and Kalshi, which had put Bolsonaro near 80% the day before the vote, and Bolsonaro said Sunday night that he does not recognize the outcome and will ask the courts to annul the election, extending political uncertainty beyond the market open.

The Ibovespa fell as much as 17% to about 170,000 points before the 10% drop trigger paused trading, and kept sliding after the 30-minute halt; for a dollar-based investor the currency and index moves combined to a loss of about 26% at their worst. Lula’s margin was about 4.4 million votes, according to Brazil’s Superior Electoral Court, while the latest Datafolha poll had the race tied at 50% each among valid votes.

title.zh: 随着AI相关市场抛售加深，比特币跌破80,000美元
title.en: Bitcoin Dips Below $80,000 as AI-Related Market Selloff Deepens

summary.zh:
据彭博社报道，随着与人工智能相关市场有关的更广泛抛售加深，比特币跌破80,000美元。此举反映出加密资产与科技资产普遍面临避险压力。

这一下跌表明，与AI相关科技交易有关的避险压力正传导至加密市场，比特币与更广泛的风险资产同步走弱。

该消息将这一跌势置于跨资产抛售的背景下，而非加密行业特定事件。
summary.en:
Bitcoin fell below $80,000 as a broader selloff tied to AI-related markets deepened, according to Bloomberg. The move reflected risk-off pressure across crypto and technology assets.

The drop signals that risk-off pressure linked to AI-related technology trades is spilling into crypto, with bitcoin trading alongside broader risk assets.

The item frames the decline as part of a cross-asset selloff rather than a crypto-specific event.

title.zh: Kraken 母公司 Payward 将为美国客户推出 CFTC 监管的期货产品
title.en: Kraken parent Payward to launch CFTC-regulated futures for US clients

summary.zh:
加密货币交易所 Kraken 的母公司 Payward 正准备面向美国客户推出受美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）监管的期货产品，扩大其受监管衍生品业务。

这将扩大 Payward 在美国客户群体中受 CFTC 监管的衍生品业务。
summary.en:
Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, is preparing to launch CFTC-regulated futures products for US clients, expanding its regulated derivatives offering.

It would expand Payward's regulated derivatives offering for US clients under CFTC oversight.

title.zh: 印度 CoinDCX 确认损失 1600 万美元，数日前其 CEO 曾称此事为“虚惊一场”
title.en: India’s CoinDCX Confirms $16 Million Loss Days After CEO Called It a ‘False Alarm’

summary.zh:
CoinDCX 在一篇博客文章中表示，10 月 21 日有 1599 万枚 USDT（约合 1600 万美元）在波场（Tron）网络上被转走，原因是内部流程未能将客户存款从其 2025 年黑客事件后停用的钱包中归集转出。这家总部位于孟买的交易所称已自行承担该损失、客户资金安全，这与其 CEO Sumit Gupta 此前公开称相关入侵报道是“虚惊一场”的说法相反。

此次承认使 CoinDCX 在 2025 年 7 月约 4400 万美元黑客事件之后的两次事件累计损失接近 6000 万美元。同时，公司公开推翻了 CEO 先前的否认，使一起曾受质疑的链上预警变成公司确认的实际损失。

此次损失涉及的钱包是此前那次入侵的遗留地址，仍不断收到残余存款，而失效的自动转账系统使这些资金处于暴露状态。链上调查者 ZachXBT 反驳了 Gupta 的说法，指出涉事钱包直到今年 4 月和 5 月仍在将用户存款归集到 CoinDCX 当前的热钱包，并呼吁客户提取资产。
summary.en:
CoinDCX said in a blog post that 15.99 million USDT (about $16 million) was drained on the Tron network on Oct. 21, after an internal process failed to sweep customer deposits out of wallets the exchange retired following its 2025 hack. The Mumbai-based exchange said it absorbed the loss itself and that customer funds remain safe, reversing CEO Sumit Gupta's earlier public claim that reports of a breach were a "false alarm."

The admission brings CoinDCX's losses from two incidents to nearly $60 million, following the roughly $44 million hack in July 2025. It also publicly reverses the CEO's denial, turning a disputed on-chain flag into a company-confirmed loss.

The retired wallets at the center of the loss were a legacy of the earlier breach and kept receiving residual deposits, which the failed automated transfer system left exposed. On-chain investigator ZachXBT disputed Gupta's account, noting the wallet in question had still been sweeping user deposits into CoinDCX's current hot wallet as recently as April and May, and urged customers to withdraw their assets.

title.zh: 【Akash 团队计划离开 Cosmos，并选定 Solana 作为迁移目标】
title.en: Akash team plans to leave Cosmos, selects Solana as migration target

summary.zh:
Akash Network 联合创始人 Greg Osuri 表示，核心团队已选定 Solana 作为迁移目标，计划让 Akash Network 离开其 Cosmos 主权链 akashnet-2，将算力市场重建为 Solana 主网上的原生程序，AKT 则成为 Solana 原生 SPL 代币。该计划尚未最终确定：团队须先在 akashnet-2 上通过治理提案（需达 33.4% 法定人数且多数赞成），并在两家独立审计完成后，AKT 才会在 Solana 上发行。

Akash 是成熟的 DePIN 算力网络，弃用自有主权链意味着取消目前用于保障网络安全的 AKT 质押与验证者结构，并将代币置于 Solana 的流动性与用户基础之中——Helium、Render、io.net 等同类 DePIN 项目已在 Solana 上运行。团队评估中的另一入围选项为以太坊 L2。

按计划，为期两年的单向迁移门户将在提案通过且审计完成后开放，AKT 按 1:1 迁移为 SPL 代币，代码、小数位与总供应量均不变。算力市场的切换时间尚未确定，需在审计和迁移演练完成后由单独的治理投票决定；切换后现有工作负载将继续运行 90 天，随后旧链停止运行，质押奖励于切换时结束，验证者角色及收入于旧链停止时结束。
summary.en:
Akash Network co-founder Greg Osuri said the project's core team has chosen Solana as the destination for migrating Akash Network off its Cosmos sovereign chain akashnet-2, rebuilding the compute marketplace as native Solana programs and turning AKT into a Solana-native SPL token. The move is not final: the team must first pass a governance proposal on akashnet-2 requiring 33.4% quorum and a majority of yes votes, followed by two independent audits before AKT is issued on Solana.

Akash is an established DePIN compute network, so dropping its own sovereign chain would remove the AKT staking and validator structure that currently secures it and place the token inside Solana's liquidity and user base, where rival DePIN projects Helium, Render and io.net already operate. Ethereum L2s were the other shortlisted option in the team's evaluation.

Under the plan, the two-year one-way migration portal opens after the proposal passes and audits complete, converting AKT 1:1 as SPL tokens with unchanged code, decimals and total supply. The compute marketplace cutover date has not been set and requires a separate governance vote after audits and migration drills; existing workloads would run 90 days after that switch before the old chain halts, with staking rewards ending at cutover and validator roles and revenue ending when the old chain stops.

title.zh: 标普全球收购 OpenZeppelin，以强化数字资产风险能力
title.en: S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin to boost digital asset risk capabilities

summary.zh:
标普全球于 2026 年 10 月 26 日宣布，已完成对区块链安全公司 OpenZeppelin 的收购。该交易于 2026 年 9 月 17 日首次公布，财务条款未披露。收购完成后，OpenZeppelin 将作为独立业务部门运营，由创始人 Demian Brener 领导，并向标普全球评级总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报。

标普全球表示，此次收购将补充其数字资产风险评估业务，帮助传统金融机构及链上金融企业评估智能合约和底层技术风险。公司还表示，预计该交易不会对其财务业绩产生重大影响。

OpenZeppelin 成立于 2015 年，提供智能合约安全审计、安全开发服务及开源合约库。公司称其安全团队已完成超过 900 项审计，在产品上线前发现超过 1 万个漏洞。标普全球表示，OpenZeppelin Contracts 将继续保持开源、免费及公开维护，该合约库所支撑的累计价值转移规模超过 38 万亿美元。
summary.en:
S&P Global said on October 26, 2026 that it has completed its acquisition of blockchain security firm OpenZeppelin, a deal first announced on September 17, 2026, with financial terms undisclosed. OpenZeppelin will operate as a standalone business unit led by founder Demian Brener, who reports to S&P Global Ratings president Yann Le Pallec.

S&P Global said the deal complements its digital asset risk assessment business and is meant to help traditional financial institutions and onchain firms evaluate smart contract and underlying technology risk. The company said it does not expect the transaction to have a material impact on its financial results.

OpenZeppelin, founded in 2015, provides smart contract audits, secure development services and open-source contract libraries; its security team says it has completed more than 900 audits and found over 10,000 vulnerabilities before product launch. S&P Global said OpenZeppelin Contracts will remain open source, free and publicly maintained, and that the cumulative value transferred through the libraries exceeds $38 trillion.

title.zh: Strive 以 5.11 亿美元购入比特币，逼近第二大企业比特币储备
title.en: Strive closes in on second-largest corporate bitcoin treasury with $511 million purchase

summary.zh:
根据美国 SEC 文件，Strive 于 10 月 17 日至 23 日以含手续费及费用的均价约 82,732 美元买入 6,182 枚比特币，耗资约 5.114 亿美元；截至 10 月 23 日，其累计持仓达 43,000 枚 BTC。这笔买入使其持仓规模逼近第二大企业比特币储备的位置。

这笔买入使 Strive 的持仓规模紧追最大的几家企业持币方，进一步强化了企业金库这一现货比特币需求渠道。据市场评论，在最大企业持有方 Strategy 当周未进行比特币购买的情况下，Strive 的买入仍在继续。

截至 10 月 23 日，Strive 持有现金及现金等价物 5.044 亿美元，较 10 月 16 日增加 1.869 亿美元；同时持有 50.5 万股 Strategy 的 STRC 优先股，公允价值约 5,018 万美元。其 A 类普通股流通股数增加约 326.6 万股至约 1.181 亿股，SATS 优先股为 700 万股，SATA 优先股维持约 1,403 万股不变；Koin Bülteni 报道称，该公司为后续进一步购买留出了空间。
summary.en:
Strive bought 6,182 bitcoin for about $511.4 million between Oct. 17 and Oct. 23 at an average price of roughly $82,732 per coin including fees and expenses, according to SEC filings, lifting its total holdings to 43,000 BTC as of Oct. 23. The purchase moves the company close to the second-largest corporate bitcoin treasury position.

The purchase places Strive just behind the largest corporate bitcoin holders, reinforcing the corporate-treasury channel as a source of spot bitcoin demand. Strive's buying has continued even as Strategy, the largest corporate holder, made no bitcoin purchase in the same week, according to market commentary.

As of Oct. 23, Strive held $504.4 million in cash and cash equivalents, up $186.9 million from Oct. 16, along with 505,000 shares of Strategy's STRC preferred stock valued at about $50.18 million at fair value. Its Class A common shares outstanding rose by about 3.266 million to roughly 118.1 million, while SATS preferred shares stood at 7 million and SATA preferred shares were unchanged at about 14.03 million; Koin Bülteni reported the company opened the door to further purchases.

title.zh: Blast常规提现界面截止日期已至，桥上仍有4041万美元资产待提取
title.en: Blast's Standard Withdrawal Interface Deadline Arrives With $40.41 Million Still on the Bridge

summary.zh:
Blast 于 10 月 26 日到达常规提现界面的截止日期，但其以太坊主网官方跨链桥中仍有约 4041 万美元资产。该金额较 10 月 2 日约 6350 万美元下降约 36%，当日 Blast 宣布将逐步关闭该 Layer 2 网络。

根据 Blast 此前的说明，10 月 26 日之后用户仍可提取资产，但必须直接与以太坊上的桥接合约交互，而不能再依赖常规网站界面。

Blast 已发布 ETH、USDB 和 BLAST 的合约级提现指南；报道描述的流程包括在 Blast 网络发起提现、等待对应状态记录提交至以太坊、通过 OptimismPortal 合约提交提现证明，再经过一天的挑战期并执行最终确认交易。报道发布时，Blast 官网仍显示提现入口及网络逐步关闭的提示。
summary.en:
Blast reached the deadline for its standard withdrawal interface on October 26, with roughly $40.41 million in assets still sitting in its official Ethereum mainnet bridge. That figure is down about 36% from approximately $63.5 million on October 2, when the Layer 2 network announced it would wind down.

After October 26, holders can still withdraw, but only by interacting directly with the bridge contracts on Ethereum rather than through the regular website interface, per Blast's prior notice.

Blast has published contract-level withdrawal guides for ETH, USDB and BLAST; the reported process involves initiating a withdrawal on Blast, waiting for the corresponding state record to be posted to Ethereum, submitting a withdrawal proof through the OptimismPortal contract, then a challenge period and a final confirmation transaction. At the time of the report, Blast's website still displayed a withdrawal entry point and notices about the network's gradual shutdown.
